title: EU Council vote
summary: The Council of the EU round a table, all 27 member states. Your code sets each one to yes, no or abstain: its flag grows and its seat lights up.
description: The Council of the EU as a vector illustration, 27 members round a table, one per member state. Set a country to yes, no or abstain and it comes alive: its flag grows to 1.6 times its size with a glow in the vote colour, the member leans in with a soft glow behind, the inner rim of its table segment turns green, red or amber, and a badge with a check, cross or dash pops in. Set it back to none and everything returns to the drawing. Every country is an enum named after its two-letter code in lower case, so a whole vote is a few lines of code. Every person, chair, table segment and flag is a named group in the file (vlag-BE, figuur-BE, tafeldeel-BE), ready for more animation in the Rive editor.

notes: Set a vote with `vm.enum("de").value = "yes"`. The values are `none`, `yes`, `no` and `abstain`; any other string is ignored.
All 27 member states have a seat, from `at` (Austria) to `se` (Sweden).

Each change animates by itself (about a third of a second): the flag pops, the rim colours, the badge appears. Setting all 27 at once reads as a wave of lights; for a dramatic count, set them one by one with a short delay.
The file does not count the votes; your page knows the values it set, so it can show the tally and decide on a qualified majority (55% of the states representing 65% of the population).
The vector source is in the repository (sources/eu-council-vote/eu-court.svg), with every person, chair, table segment and flag as a named group.
